newsitem.title: PERU: JP Morgan to lend Peru's Backus $100 mln -official.
newsitem.headline: JP Morgan to lend Peru's Backus $100 mln -official.

text.p: Investment bank J.P. Morgan & Co has agreed to lend Peru's top brewer Union de Cervecerias Peruanas Backus y Johnston $100 million to refinance short- and long-term debt, officials said Friday.
Backus will have one year's grace before paying the debt off over four years, the Lima Stock Exchange said in a report.
The interest rate for the loan will be based on LIBOR, the stock exchange said. It did not specify the amount.

Backus y Johnston group shareholders merged December 30, 1996, Cerveceria Backus y Johnston with its three sister companies Compania Nacional de Cerveza SA, Sociedad Cervecera de Trujillo SA and Cerveceria del Norte SA .
